author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Esteury Ruiz swipes bag Friday
desc: Esteury Ruiz drew three walks and logged a stolen base in Friday's 3-2 loss against the Cleveland Guardians.
impact: Ruiz didn't record a base hit in his start on Friday, but he reached base safely three times and swiped a bag. He's been limited to 12 at-bats in July, yet he's already tallied four stolen bases, pushing his season total to 20. He's best left on waivers until he receives more consistent playing time.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Heriberto Hernandez goes deep Friday
desc: Heriberto Hernandez went 1-for-3 with a home run, a walk, one run scored and an RBI in Friday's 3-2 loss against the Cleveland Guardians.
impact: Hernandez hit a solo homer in the sixth inning off Parker Messick, giving the Miami Marlins their first run of the game. He's off to a terrific start in July, posting a .346/.452/1.038 slash line with five home runs. He's worth streaming in deeper leagues while he's riding this hot streak at the plate.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Leo Jimenez goes deep Friday
desc: Leo Jimenez went 1-for-3 with a solo home run in Friday's 3-2 loss against the Cleveland Guardians.
impact: Jimenez launched a 407-foot home run off Erik Sabrowski in the seventh, his second of the season. He's started in back-to-back games for the Miami Marlins and is starting to show what he can do at the plate, going 3-for-7 with a homer, two runs scored and two RBI over that stretch. He's posted a .292/.346/.583 slash line across his last 24 at-bats.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Nick Martinez picks up win Friday
desc: Nick Martinez allowed two runs on four hits and one walk while striking out one across 5.1 innings in Friday's 7-2 win over the Seattle Mariners.
impact: Martinez recorded just one strikeout on Friday, marking the third time this season he has logged only one punchout. However, he still rewarded fantasy managers by allowing just two runs and earning his eighth win of the year. On the season, he owns a 2.65 ERA and 1.12 WHIP. He is not expected to pitch again until after the All-Star break.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Richie Palacios blasts one over fence Friday
desc: Richie Palacios went 1-for-4 with a solo home run in Friday's 7-2 win over the Seattle Mariners.
impact: Palacios hit a 396-foot homer off Luis Castillo in the fourth inning, his third of the season. He owns a .245/.336/.349 slash line with eight stolen bases on the year.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Cedric Mullins II clears fence Friday
desc: Cedric Mullins II went 1-for-4 with a solo home run in Friday's 7-2 win over the Seattle Mariners.
impact: Mullins hadn't recorded a hit since July 4, but changed that on Friday thanks to a 378-foot home run off Luis Castillo in the fifth inning. While he owns just a .188 AVG in July, he's homered three times, showcasing some pop. He owns a .205/.284/.348 slash line with 11 homers and 14 stolen bases across 80 games this season.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Victor Mesa Jr. connects for homer Friday
desc: Victor Mesa Jr. went 3-for-4 with a home run, one run scored, one RBI and a stolen base in Friday's 7-2 win over the Seattle Mariners.
impact: Mesa had himself an evening, recording his first three-hit game of the season, which included a 392-foot homer off Luis Castillo in the fifth inning. He's been great in July, posting a .280/.345/.560 slash line with two homers. He's started for the Tampa Bay Rays in four of their last five games, making him a nice short-term option while he's swinging a hot bat.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Junior Caminero hits homer Friday
desc: Junior Caminero went 2-for-4 with a home run, a double, a walk, two runs scored and two RBI in Friday's 7-2 win over the Seattle Mariners.
impact: Caminero blasted a 385-foot homer off lefty Jose Ferrer for his 28th of the season. He's now gone deep in back-to-back games and has five homers in July. He owns a .266 AVG and .847 OPS on the year.

author: Nate Miller
title: Derek Hill provides all the offense for Phillies on Friday
desc: Derek Hill went 3-for-4 with a solo homer, two singles, and two RBI in Friday's 10-2 loss to the Tigers.
impact: Getting in the starting lineup for the first time since Tuesday, Hill took advantage of the opportunity with his seventh homer of the year in the third inning, following that up with an RBI single in the next frame. The 30-year-old outfielder has swung the bat very well since being traded to Philadelphia last month, batting .356 with a .983 OPS, three home runs, and two doubles over 48 plate appearances.

author: Nate Miller
title: Aaron Nola strikes out eight Friday night
desc: Aaron Nola gave up two runs on three hits and two walks while striking out eight over five innings in Friday's 10-2 loss to the Tigers.
impact: The strikeouts are the one thing that has been there for Nola this season, as he is now up to 102 through 97 innings. Aside from that, the veteran righty has been wildly inconsistent, posting a 5.75 ERA and 1.43 WHIP over 19 starts. Nola has been more good than bad recently, but the blowups have been unpredictable.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Munetaka Murakami to participate in Home Run Derby
desc: Munetaka Murakami has been named as the final participant in Monday's Home Run Derby.
impact: Murakami was activated from the injured list on Friday. He has taken the league by storm, launching 20 home runs this season entering Friday.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Brewers/Pirates postponed Friday
desc: Friday's contest between the Milwaukee Brewers and Pittsburgh Pirates has been postponed due to inclement weather.
impact: The originally scheduled contest between the two clubs will be made up as part of a split doubleheader beginning at 12:05 PM Saturday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Braydon Fisher activated from bereavement list
desc: Braydon Fisher was reinstated from the bereavement list.
impact: Fisher was away from the team for the past few days. He rejoins the Blue Jays on Friday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Shohei Ohtani to have knee drained Sunday
desc: Dodgers manager Dave Roberts said Shohei Ohtani will have his left knee drained on Sunday.
impact: Ohtani was scratched from his scheduled start on Sunday and will not participate in the All-Star game next week. He'll take next week to get healthy.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Vince Velasquez signs minor league deal with Royals
desc: The Royals signed RHP Vince Velasquez to a minor league contract.
impact: Velasquez previously elected free agency from the Cubs organization. He will add pitching depth in the Royals organization.
